title: Fleet island manifest (fleet/islands/<theme>/island.json)
description: Written by HQ (or the user). The bridge reads it to spawn sessions; fleet-lint validates it. Islands read it, never edit it.

theme.description: Must equal the directory name and a world ThemeId.

role.description: One sentence: what this department owns.

model.description: Default model for sessions started on this island. Never fable.

maxChildren.description: Hand-off sessions one request may open from here (M42).

allowedTools.description: Passed as --allowedTools. Edit/Write are confined by .claude/settings.json deny rules.

addDirs.description: Extra writable roots (--add-dir), relative to the repo root. HQ gets "fleet"; others usually [].

owner.description: Who may change this manifest and the settings file.

agents.description: Island sub-agent names (.claude/agents/<name>.md) offered in the panel's agent picker; 'default' = the CLAUDE.md persona.

accent.description: Overrides the world ISLAND_ACCENTS colour in the panel.
